roster: All 18 main_three_seed checkpoints from final-test-plan.json; no checkpoint selection changes
grouping_source: fitting interactions only; existing fitting-degree head/tail item labels
grouping_rule: Let t be the number of tail fitting interactions and n the number of fitting interactions. head_oriented if 3*t <= n; tail_oriented if 3*t >= 2*n; mixed otherwise. Empty histories are an error.
metrics: Existing six ranking metrics within each group; macro Recall/NDCG over users, tail Recall only over users with held-out tail positives
verification: Reproduce each frozen overall test metric within 1e-6 and exact per-item exposure before accepting grouped results; group exposures and user denominators must sum to overall
interpretation: Descriptive observed-history groups, not true preferences or causal fairness effects. Three training seeds share the same users and split. No tuning or model selection from this analysis.
